item.title: Ask HN: What paid tools have you now replaced with personalized AI-coded tools?
item.summary: I was considering doing this with Rewind.ai since it shut down. I've since then run across ScreenPipe, which I may use, or I may modify their open source version to make it more personalized. I'm curious what other tools people have done this for and the most feasible and useful categories of tools for personalized AI versions.
